# National Tax Group

> > National Tax Group helps businesses maximize tax incentives through R&D credits, cost segregation, energy efficiency deductions, and strategic tax planning.

National Tax Group specializes in identifying and implementing lucrative tax incentives and deductions for commercial businesses, real estate owners, architects, and design firms. The firm offers comprehensive services spanning R&D tax credits, Section 179D energy efficiency deductions, cost segregation studies, and green energy financing programs.

## Key Topics

- Section 179D (Energy Efficiency Tax Deduction)
- R&D Tax Credits
- Cost Segregation Studies
- 45L Tax Credit
- HVAC Systems
- Commercial Real Estate Tax
- Energy Efficiency Incentives
- CPA Partnerships
- PACE/C-PACE Financing
- Building Energy Modeling
- SBA 504 Green Loans
- Tax Deductions
- Business Tax Incentives
- Green Initiatives
- Section 174 Research Credits

## Core Tax Incentive Services

- [Services - National Tax Group](https://ntgadvantage.com/services-2): Main services page featuring R&D credits, 179D, cost segregation, and 45L tax incentives.
- [Section 179D Deduction – Energy Efficiency Tax Incentives](https://ntgadvantage.com/services/179d-energy-efficient-tax-deduction): Section 179D energy-efficient building upgrade deductions up to $5.85/sq ft for commercial properties.
- [R&D Tax Credits: Maximize Your Business Savings](https://ntgadvantage.com/services/rd-tax-credit): R&D tax credits and Form 6765 guidance for research and development activities.
- [Cost Segregation Services | Expert Analysis And Consultation](https://ntgadvantage.com/services/cost-segregation-studies): Cost segregation studies for tax deferral, depreciation acceleration, and improved cash flow.

- [Energy Consulting Services – National Tax Group](https://ntgadvantage.com/services/energy-consulting): Energy consulting and advisory services for commercial and industrial firms.
